Mixed topics.question: 1) Detection of hidden disease among apparently healthy population is called:
Mixed topics.exp: Screening detects unrecognized disease among apparently healthy people. It is not diagnostic. Positive screening results need confirmation.

Mixed topics.question: 2) Example of probability sampling is:
Mixed topics.exp: Stratified random sampling is a probability sampling method. Each subgroup is represented. Quota, purposive and accidental sampling are non-probability methods.

Mixed topics.question: 3) The vaccine given at birth in EPI is:
Mixed topics.exp: BCG is given at birth. Penta and IPV start later. MR-1 is given at 9 months.

Mixed topics.question: 4) Minimum recommended ANC visits in the older WHO schedule is:
Mixed topics.exp: The older minimum ANC schedule included 4 visits. Updated WHO 2016 schedule recommends 8 contacts. Ideal visit number is mentioned separately as 14.

Mixed topics.question: 5) Universally accepted indicator of health status of a population is:
Mixed topics.exp: IMR is regarded as the most important universal health indicator. It reflects level of living. It also reflects MCH service effectiveness.

Mixed topics.question: 6) PQLI includes IMR, literacy and:
Mixed topics.exp: PQLI has three components. They are infant mortality rate, life expectancy at age one and literacy. Income is not directly included.

Mixed topics.question: 7) The submerged portion of iceberg phenomenon indicates:
Mixed topics.exp: The submerged part includes latent, subclinical, undiagnosed cases and carriers. These are not usually seen clinically. Known morbidity is only the visible tip.

Mixed topics.question: 8) The first stage of disease cycle is:
Mixed topics.exp: Incubation period starts after entry of disease agent. There are no clinical signs or symptoms. Prodrome comes later.

Mixed topics.question: 9) Feedback in communication mainly helps to:
Mixed topics.exp: Feedback completes communication. It helps the sender assess understanding. It allows correction of confusion.

Mixed topics.question: 10) Noise and congestion are examples of:
Mixed topics.exp: Noise and congestion interfere with communication through surroundings. They reduce attention and clarity. They are environmental barriers.

Mixed topics.question: 11) Home visit is an example of:
Mixed topics.exp: Home visit is an individual method. It allows personal contact. It helps understand family and living conditions.

Mixed topics.question: 12) Television and radio are examples of:
Mixed topics.exp: Television and radio reach large populations. They are mass communication methods. They are useful for awareness creation.

Mixed topics.question: 13) Male condom is classified as:
Mixed topics.exp: Male condom acts as a mechanical barrier. It blocks sperm entry. It also protects against STI including HIV.

Mixed topics.question: 14) Lippes loop is:
Mixed topics.exp: Lippes loop is a first-generation IUCD. It is non-medicated or inert. Copper devices are second-generation IUCDs.

Mixed topics.question: 15) Cu-T 380A is:
Mixed topics.exp: Cu-T 380A is a copper-bearing IUCD. Copper enhances contraceptive action. It works by spermicidal action and local endometrial reaction.

Mixed topics.question: 16) LNG-IUS is:
Mixed topics.exp: LNG-IUS releases levonorgestrel. It thickens cervical mucus. It also causes endometrial suppression.

Mixed topics.question: 17) Levonorgestrel emergency pill should be taken within:
Mixed topics.exp: Levonorgestrel emergency pill is used within 72 hours. Earlier use is better. Copper IUD and ulipristal acetate have a 5-day window.

Mixed topics.question: 18) DMPA is commonly given every:
Mixed topics.exp: DMPA is an injectable contraceptive. It is commonly given every 3 months. NET-EN is given every 2 months.

Mixed topics.question: 19) Lactational amenorrhoea method is effective up to:
Mixed topics.exp: LAM works when mother is amenorrhoeic, fully breastfeeding and within 6 months postpartum. All criteria must be fulfilled. If any criterion is absent, another method is needed.

Mixed topics.question: 20) Neonatal period is:
Mixed topics.exp: Neonatal period means first 28 days of life. Post-neonatal period is from 28th day to 1 year. Infancy is birth to 1 year.

Mixed topics.question: 21) IMR is expressed per:
Mixed topics.exp: IMR is infant deaths under 1 year per 1,000 live births. It is measured for a given year. It reflects child health and living standard.

Mixed topics.question: 22) MMR is expressed per:
Mixed topics.exp: MMR is maternal deaths per 100,000 live births. It reflects maternal health service quality. Hemorrhage is a major cause.

Mixed topics.question: 23) In TORCH, C stands for:
Mixed topics.exp: C in TORCH stands for cytomegalovirus. It can cross placenta. It may cause congenital infection.

Mixed topics.question: 24) Bangladesh is in which demographic cycle stage?
Mixed topics.exp: Bangladesh is placed in late expanding stage. Birth rate tends to fall. Death rate declines further.

Mixed topics.question: 25) Males are shown on which side of age-sex pyramid?
Mixed topics.exp: In population pyramid, males are shown on the left. Females are shown on the right. Age groups are arranged vertically.

Mixed topics.question: 26) Prevalence equals:
Mixed topics.exp: The relationship is P = I × D. Prevalence increases with higher incidence. It also increases with longer disease duration.

Mixed topics.question: 27) A study starting with exposed and unexposed groups is:
Mixed topics.exp: Cohort study begins with exposure status. Exposed and unexposed groups are followed over time. It can measure incidence.

Mixed topics.question: 28) Quarantine is applied to:
Mixed topics.exp: Quarantine is for healthy but exposed individuals. It is maintained for the incubation period. Isolation is for sick or infected individuals.

Mixed topics.question: 29) Highly sensitive test is useful to:
Mixed topics.exp: High sensitivity gives few false negatives. A negative result helps rule out disease. This is the SnNout idea.

Mixed topics.question: 30) The agreement controlling ozone-depleting substances is:
Mixed topics.exp: Montreal Protocol controls ozone-depleting substances such as CFCs. Kyoto Protocol is related to greenhouse gas reduction. Paris Agreement is related to global warming control.
